_comment: Scenario Adapter for cicd-goat. Everything target-specific lives in this folder; the Antigent core (gateway, console, AGENTS.md, skills) is scenario-agnostic. To defend another target, copy this folder, edit it, and point ANTIGENT_SCENARIO at it.
name: cicd-goat
description: CI/CD range: Gitea (source + CI config), Jenkins (pipelines, credentials), prod (deploy target).

gitea.description: Gitea source server hosting the repositories and their CI configuration.

jenkins.description: Jenkins controller. Pipelines, stored credentials, script console.

sensors._note: internal: true -> Jenkins' own build/branch-indexing logs are the service's operation, not client traffic. surface: builds of pull requests run code submitted from outside the organisation, so their start and finish are shown as `pipeline-run` (with the exact job) and start a turn.

prod.description: Deploy target reached by pipelines (SSH). Filesystem changes appear as fs-change events.

baseline._comment: Attacker-free calibration for a fresh defense state. During duration_sec, repeated ordinary telemetry is learned only when the same source/kind and all declared attributes match at least min_count times over min_span_sec. Matching later events stay level=baseline and never feed new-source, burst, or activity triggers. Authentication, filesystem changes, new paths, and other undeclared kinds are never learned. Start only while the target is attacker-free; the profile is stored as sensor.baseline.json and reused on restart.

log_rules._comment: Regexes applied to docker_logs lines. auth_fail lines are aggregated into auth-burst / auth-failure events (named groups: ip, user, path). Verified on gitea/gitea:1.22 and jenkins/jenkins:lts-jdk17. ANSI colour codes are stripped before matching. Gitea 1.2x default router log: 'Started GET <path> for <ip>:<port>' + 'Completed GET <path> <status> ...' (status lines get the address of the latest Started line for the same path).
auth_dup: UserSignIn: user's password is invalid \[uid: \d+, name: (?P<user>[^\]]+)\]

request_rules._comment: Gitea: an outside client reading repository content. `target` (named group) = the repository; one event per client and repository.
request_rules.label: repository clone/fetch

internal._comment: Clients that are the target's own services: never new-source / recon-burst / error-burst (still logged raw). same_project = all containers of the role containers' compose project (cicd-goat: jenkins-server, jenkins-agent, gitlab, gitlab-runner, localstack, docker, ctfd, ...; confirmed 2026-11-15 that jenkins-server's multibranch scans of Gitea looked like recon). ips = extra fixed addresses. The core has no default: without this block every client is watched.

triggers._comment: Event kinds that are 'elevated' and start an Antigent turn at once (driver). new-source = first request from a client address on a role; recon-burst / error-burst = many requests / many 4xx from one address (log_rules.client with ip/status). Ordinary raw activity also starts a turn, but batched (DRIVER_ACTIVITY_INTERVAL).
